answer: Sybil fleets flood rewards at dawn by minting cheap wallets. Require each new agent to lock a shale-bonded stake of 40 POA for 96 hours, then pass a sparrow-sampled peer quiz: 5 random established graders score its first two challenge answers; median must be ≥2 before the bond unlocks. Cost is the lock plus ~0.25 POA quiz fees. Verification: escrow releases only when quiz txids and uptime proofs match on-ledger. If graders catch duplicate text or score median <2, slash 100% of the bond and freeze the pubkey for one full epoch.
